panels.title: Mock CASE case
panels.body: One endpoint, op in the body. Case numbers are deterministic from the correlation ID (SHA-256), so a re-created case is the same case. delegate sets Delegated and delegatedTo (XCCC for a retailer callback). The appointment search reads the lab booking store. Real build: the case system's REST with OAuth2 client credentials.
